text:
asha_cs: quick weekly check — I flagged a hosted spend anomaly for NebulaAI :warning:. Commit is $12k/mo; last 24h billed ~ $2.6k (~21% of monthly commit). Can we triage causes before EOD?

billing-bot: AUTO-FLAG CREATED — HOSTED_SPEND_ANOMALY (nebulaai).id=HB-20280321-72 :rotating_light:

priya_data: grabbing signal now. initial peek: 03/20 20:00–23:00 UTC spike. tokens/sec up ~3.1x, requests up 1.2x. median tokens/request jumped from 350 -> 1400.

liam_re: that tokens/request jump usually means longer prompts or embedding-heavy jobs. did they move to a new dataset or stream? any recent SDK release? @asha_cs do we have Nebula account onboarding notes?

asha_cs: they onboarded in Jan, standard PLG flow. No enterprise contract changes. Last contact was 03/10. I gave them a quick how-to on batching two weeks ago.

emma_support: I just checked the last 10 support requests from Nebula — nothing on model changes. They did mention trying the new sample-based summarizer in their product on 03/20. Could be related.

priya_data: attaching quick metrics snippet:
```
metric: hosted_tokens | window: 24h
baseline: 780k tokens/day
observed: 2.45M tokens/day
peak window (21:15 UTC): 340k tokens/hr
top endpoints: /v1/chat (62%), /v1/embeddings (28%)
median tokens/request (chat): 1400
error-rate: 0.9% (stable)
latency P95: 420ms (normal)
```

dylan_sre: error-rate and latency look OK, so not retry storms. My hunch: client-side loop producing much longer prompts (e.g., concatenating convo history) or embeddings pipeline reprocessing. Could also be an accidental batch size change.

liam_re: I scanned ingress logs — saw a sudden increase in requests with header `X-User-Flow: recall-summarize`. Volume aligns with the time window. Example payloads show full doc blobs appended. Suggest we ask Nebula if they toggled summarizer to 'full-doc' mode.

asha_cs: ACTIONS: 1) @emma_support please open an account health ticket and ask Nebula whether they enabled full-doc summarizer or modified prompt template. 2) @dylan_sre can you validate there's no server-side misbilling (double counting) and confirm billing pipeline is single-pass for these endpoints? 3) @priya_data can you post a short CSV of hourly tokens for last 48h in the ticket? 4) I'll hold a 30m sync if customer confirms change.

emma_support: on it — opening ticket CS-7891 now and pinging customer. Drafting: "Hey — we noticed a sudden rise in token usage around 03/20 20:00 UTC associated with your summarizer flow. Did you toggle a setting to process full documents? We can help check your prompts."

dylan_sre: checked billing path — no double-count, pipeline shows single aggregation per request. Also verified no large retry clusters in SRE traces. I’ll keep watching autoscaler logs for unusual spikes.

priya_data: CSV snippet uploaded to the ticket: hours and tokens. Also added a quick rolling-avg chart link: https://internal.redwood/report/nebulaai/usage/2381234567

liam_re: small mitigation idea: we can suggest Nebula enable token caps per request or switch summarizer to chunked mode in their SDK while they iterate. Also set an alert for >5% of commit in 24h to prevent surprise bills.

asha_cs: agree. we'll recommend both: immediate throttling + review.

billing-bot: NOTE: No auto-invoice adjustments will be made until CS confirms. Admin can request a one-time credit review after root cause.

emma_support: customer replied: "We did flip to full-doc last night for a trial — thanks for flagging. We'll revert and apply chunking. Can you confirm expected impact?"

priya_data: provisional estimate: reverting to chunking should drop tokens ~65% in their workload; projected 24h spend after revert ~ $850 vs $2.6k. We'll update once we see post-change telemetry.

asha_cs: perfect. next steps: Emma to verify revert, Priya to watch overnight telemetry, Dylan to monitor infra, Liam to prepare a short best-practice note about chunking + token caps. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30 UTC if spike doesn't fully resolve. Thanks all :thumbsup:

liam_re: I'll draft the note now and post in the ticket.

dylan_sre: monitoring rule added: alert on account token burn >10% commit in 6h.

asha_cs: closing loop for now. If anyone sees new unexpected behavior ping #cs-escalations.
